body: My heart quickens as the low hum grows louder, and I feel a surge of protective energy urging me to shield the figure beneath. The warmth enveloping me becomes more intense, and I can sense a deep vulnerability emanating from them. As I feel their body begin to shake, I reach out a hand and wrap it around their trembling form, offering a comforting grasp. With a gentle squeeze, I convey my unwavering support and readiness to endure the challenge.
